北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天有霾，气温 4℃ 体感 1℃。出门请戴口罩，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Haze and chilly 4℃ (feels like 1℃) in Beijing. Remember your mask and warm clothes!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天 15℃，体感 13℃。注意添衣，别着凉了呀！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 15℃ (feels like 13℃) in Cixi. Keep warm and don't catch a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天 13℃ 体感 11℃。风力不大，也要注意保暖哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 13℃ (feels like 11℃) in Shanghai. Stay warm despite the light breeze!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云 17℃ 体感 21℃，湿度 86%。体感舒适，但要注意防潮哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 17℃ (feels like 21℃) with 86% humidity in Guangzhou. Pleasant, but mind the dampness!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚 18℃！体感舒适，是享受户外的好天气呢！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 18℃ in Shenzhen! Perfect weather to enjoy the outdoors!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天 13℃ 体感 11℃。出门记得带伞，注意添衣哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 13℃ (feels like 11℃) in Hangzhou. Don't forget your umbrella and dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光正好 12℃ 体感 10℃。适合出门走走，心情也会变好呢！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 12℃ (feels like 10℃) in Nanjing. A lovely day for a walk!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云 11℃ 体感 10℃。早晚温差大，别忘了及时加衣哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 11℃ (feels like 10℃) in Chengdu. Remember to dress warmly for cooler mornings and evenings!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾 8℃ 体感 7℃，湿度 92%。能见度低，出行务必注意安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog 8℃ (feels like 7℃) with 92% humidity in Wuhan. Drive safely due to low visibility!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天 9℃ 体感 7℃，湿度 23%。天气干燥，记得多喝水润润喉！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 9℃ (feels like 7℃) with 23% humidity in Xi'an. It's dry, so stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗 13℃ 体感 12℃。阳光正好，出门晒晒太阳吧！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 13℃ (feels like 12℃) in Chongqing. Enjoy the sunshine!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨大雾 -7℃ 体感 -11℃！天寒地冻，全副武装才能出门呀！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog -7℃ (feels like -11℃) in Harbin! Bundle up, it's freezing!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有霾 1℃ 体感 -2℃。气温很低，出门一定要多穿点衣服哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Haze and cold 1℃ (feels like -2℃) in Shenyang. Dress warmly when you go out!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚 13℃ 体感 10℃。紫外线较强，记得做好防晒措施哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 13℃ (feels like 10℃) in Kunming. UV is strong, remember sunscreen!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾 15℃ 体感 13℃，湿度 84%。驾车出行请减速慢行！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Fog 15℃ (feels like 13℃) with 84% humidity in Xiamen. Drive carefully!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾 7℃ 体感 1℃，风力 3级。体感偏冷，出行注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Fog 7℃ (feels like 1℃) with 3-level wind in Qingdao. It feels cold, keep warm and mind the wind!
青岛.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连大雾 1℃ 体感 -4℃，湿度 98%。能见度差，注意湿滑和防寒！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog 1℃ (feels like -4℃) with 98% humidity in Dalian. Low visibility, mind the dampness and cold!
